mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEDIA (PLACE_ID, TYPE, CONTENT, RATING, WRITER) VALUES (#{placeId}, #{type}, #{content}, #{rating}, #{writer})
mapper.select: SELECT m.ME_NO AS me_no, m.PLACE_ID AS placeId, m.TYPE AS type, m.CONTENT AS content, m.RATING AS rating, m.WRITER AS writer, mb.M_NICKNAME AS writerNickname FROM MEDIA m LEFT JOIN MEMBER2 mb ON mb.M_NO = m.WRITER WHERE m.PLACE_ID = #{placeId} AND m.TYPE = 'review' ORDER BY m.ME_NO DESC
SELECT ME_NO AS me_no, PLACE_ID AS placeId, TYPE AS type, CONTENT AS content, RATING AS rating, WRITER AS writer FROM MEDIA WHERE PLACE_ID = #{placeId} AND TYPE = #{type} ORDER BY ME_NO DESC
SELECT ME_NO AS me_no, PLACE_ID AS placeId, TYPE AS type, CONTENT AS content, RATING AS rating, WRITER AS writer FROM MEDIA WHERE ME_NO = #{me_no}
